messages:
jordan: Hey team — quick question. Need to start emergency unpaid leave tomorrow for ~2 weeks. I have 1 week PTO left. How do I file the extra week unpaid, and what happens to benefits / accruals? Do I need manager + payroll signoff before tomorrow?
sarah-people-ops: Sorry to hear that, jordan. Short answer: submit the LOA form and get manager confirmation. We can expedite payroll if needed. See internal guide: https://intranet.redwood.company/hr/unpaid-leave
people-ops-bot: FYI: Unpaid leave workflow updated (policy v2.1) — LOA form: https://intranet.redwood.company/hr/forms/LOA
mohammed-eng: I can approve on my side. Jordan — do you want me to cover your oncall and meetings next week? Also please DM me the dates so I can add to calendar.
jordan: Thanks @mohammed-eng — yes please cover oncall. I DM'd the dates.
emily-hr: Couple of specifics: 1) PTO: use your remaining 1 week of PTO first; the additional week is unpaid and requires LOA submission. 2) Benefits: employer-covered health benefits continue for up to 30 days of unpaid leave; after 30 days you will be moved to continuation options (we'll send COBRA/continuation packet). 3) Accruals: vacation accruals pause after 30 consecutive unpaid days — accrual for the unpaid week will not post.
people-ops-bot: Payroll cutoff reminder: Friday 12:00pm PT for changes to be applied to next pay run. If you need retro adjustment after leave, submit LOA + payroll@redwood.company within 72 hours.
tess: Quick question for payroll — if the unpaid week overlaps with the company holiday week, does the holiday pay still apply?
emily-hr: If you are on approved unpaid leave that includes a company holiday, holiday pay is handled case-by-case. Typically if you have PTO available and mark the holiday as PTO, you get paid; if you are fully unpaid for that period we treat the holiday as unpaid unless manager/people-ops pre-approves coverage. Send the exact dates and we will flag it.
jordan: Understood. One last thing — will my stock vesting / performance cycle be affected?
emily-hr: Short leaves under 30 days don't affect vesting. For longer leaves we evaluate per the equity plan language; we'll pull your vesting schedule and confirm.
sarah-people-ops: Action items for jordan: 1) fill LOA form (link above) 2) cc payroll@redwood.company with dates if you need expedited processing 3) @mohammed-eng confirm coverage in the LOA submission 4) people-ops will follow up on benefits packet. Happy to help — ping if anything urgent. :heart:
jordan: Thanks everyone — submitting LOA now. Appreciate the quick responses.
